notes.title: Ultimate Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

First of all, I would like to thank you if you have played Impact Trial: First Encounter.

In a few days it will be 6 months since its release, and I wanted to make a "ultimate update" with the following changes:


 Now you can go beyond the edges of the screen, even more retro!
 You can choose between automatic shooting or normal shooting.
 The combat system has been optimized so that it doesn't consume so many computational resources.


With this, I say goodbye to Impact Trial: First Encounter and the journey to the next game begins. I only hope that if you have played it at the beginning, at the moment I am writing this, or in the future, you have enjoyed it as much as I have enjoyed creating it.

I only ask one thing, if you play Impact Trial: First Encounter, please leave a review, it will help to spread the word about the game. I will thank you from the bottom of my heart.

Thanks for playing the game!
Nothing more to add,
Best regards,
